details.description: Whisper Tiny is the smallest checkpoint (39M parameters) in OpenAI's open-source Whisper family of speech recognition models, trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual, multitask audio and able to transcribe speech and translate it into English. Deepgram hosts it as part of its "Whisper Cloud" offering, layering diarization and word timings on top of the open model for pre-recorded audio. Deepgram's docs list 99 supported language codes for its Whisper models.
advantages: OpenAI's README describes the six Whisper sizes as offering "speed and accuracy tradeoffs," with tiny the fastest and lowest-resource of the family (about 1 GB VRAM, roughly 10x the relative inference speed of the large model).
Deepgram pairs Whisper Cloud with diarization and word timings, which Deepgram says are not available through OpenAI's own API.
Trained on 680,000 hours of audio covering 98 languages per OpenAI's model card, giving it broad multilingual coverage for its size.
disadvantages: Deepgram does not support live streaming with Whisper Cloud; only pre-recorded audio up to 20 minutes of processing time is supported.

Deepgram calls its Whisper models "less scalable than all other Deepgram models" and caps Whisper requests at 15 concurrent calls on paid plans (5 on pay-as-you-go), recommending a Deepgram model such as Nova instead if it meets the need.

As the smallest Whisper checkpoint, tiny is the least accurate of the sizes Deepgram offers, and OpenAI notes its English-only ".en" variant (not the one offered here) performs better than the multilingual version at this size.
OpenAI's model card reports the Whisper family is prone to hallucination and shows disparate performance across accents and dialects.
Deepgram does not support Entity Detection, Keywords, Profanity Filter, or Search with Whisper Cloud models.
use_cases: Low-latency, resource-constrained transcription of pre-recorded audio where speed matters more than maximum accuracy

sources.title: openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision

notes: Re-checked the Deepgram Whisper Cloud page directly: its "Supported languages" section names all 99 language codes inline (en, zh, de, ... jw, su), not just 56, so the list has been mapped to English names and filled in rather than left empty. No WER or other accuracy figures specific to the tiny checkpoint were found on maker or host pages, so evaluations remains empty.
